facts.fact: The World Bank's amendment to the Digital Gabon Project loan agreement, countersigned by Gabon's Minister of Economy on 2 September 2026, finances developing and providing authentication services based on the national identification number (NIP) for access to services.
The amended Digital Gabon financing agreement (effective 2 September 2026) provides for a fully digitalised civil registry system that is interoperable with, and distinct from, the RBPP ID system.

facts.fact: The amended Digital Gabon financing agreement (effective 2 September 2026) provides for integrating the CNAM-GS social protection beneficiary registry into the Interoperability Platform and linking it to the RBPP ID system.
The amended Digital Gabon financing agreement (effective 2 September 2026) refers to the existing social protection beneficiary registry managed by CNAM-GS and finances improving it.
